scripts.data: uv run --with zstandard python tools/extract_rpd.py && npm run scene:import && npm run scene:export
scripts.quest: npm run quest:grid && npm run quest:data && npm run nav:build
scripts.plan:build: uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with opencv-python-headless python tools/rpd_plan.py && blender -b -P tools/plan_scene.py && node tools/write_asset_version.mjs
scripts.icons: uv run --with zstandard --with texture2ddecoder --with pillow python tools/extract_item_icons.py
scripts.item-models: uv run --with zstandard --with texture2ddecoder --with pillow python tools/extract_item_models.py
scripts.item-models:check: blender -b -P tools/render_item_models.py && uv run --with pillow python tools/item_model_sheet.py
